lines.1: It was the rainy season all right--it had poured since morning.
lines.2: --But by the time school ended, it had stopped.
lines.5: She suddenly gave me a light smack on the head.
lines.8: She flicked up one hand in greeting.
lines.9: She was getting just a little sports-club-ish herself.
lines.11: 「So? Is the notebook I lent you yesterday helping?」
lines.12: 「Yeah. Having that much detail is a huge help.」
lines.14: 「Here. These are my own summary sheets for the test range. Do these and it'll be even easier.」
lines.15: Konoe presented me with a stack of papers.
lines.22: 「You're... actually incredibly nice! Going this far for me!」
lines.23: 「N-no! I just don't want you blaming your bad grades on helping the drama club. That's ALL.」
lines.24: 「Either way, after you've done this much for me, I'm gonna work hard!」
lines.25: 「Deep down, you really are simple, aren't you?」
lines.26: 「I think the same goes for you.」
lines.27: 「I'm a maiden, you know. A maiden's heart is complicated.」
lines.30: 「Actually, now I'm the one who owes you.」
lines.31: 「I'm Otome's kid brother, after all. I repay my debts properly.」
lines.32: 「Repay me? What could YOU possibly give me?」
lines.33: 「Ugh. When you put it that way... fair point.」
lines.34: She was smarter than me, after all.
lines.35: 「Oh! Want me to tell you a bookstore that doesn't mind you standing around reading? You can stay for like three hours!」
lines.37: 「...Ughhh. Then what am I supposed to give you?」
lines.40: 「Oh! Want me to show you a tree that's great for catching cicadas?」
lines.44: She nailed me with a perfect retort.
lines.46: 「Come on, there have to be more things! Use your brain!」
lines.49: 「Here. A set of ten winning gum coupons.」
lines.52: 「I'll figure it out later. Give me some time to think.」
lines.53: 「...Honestly. I don't know whether to call that pathetic or what.」
lines.54: 「I'll wait without getting my hopes up.」
lines.58: 「Anyway, I'll pay you back somehow. You free Saturday after exams?」
lines.60: 「Then keep it open. I'll thank you properly that day.」
lines.61: 「Fine. I'll keep it open for you.」
lines.64: Then she looked back one last time.
lines.66: Nagging me right up to the very end.
